aligned_nanopore_file.description: name and path of file with aligned reads

aligned_nanopore_id.description:
identifier for aligned_nanopore (primary key)

Notes: experiment_short_read_id + alignment indicator

aligned_nanopore_index_file.description: name and path of index file corresponding to aligned reads file

alignment_software.description:
Software including version number

Notes: Can be unknown if RC receives external data

analysis_details.description: brief description of the analysis pipeline used for producing the file; perhaps a DOI or link to something like a WDL file or github repository

contamination.description: Contamination level estimate., e.g. <1% (display raw fraction not percent)

fiberseq_format.description:
Indicates if BAM file has been formatted using fibertools to include nucleosome and methyltransferase-sensitive patch (MSP) calls

Notes: See https://fiberseq.github.io/index.html for details on methods and Fiber-seq BAM specific tags

genome_coverage.description: e.g. >=90% at 10x or 20x; per consortium decision

mean_coverage.description:
Mean coverage of either the genome or the targeted regions

Notes: Can be unknown if RC receives external data

methylation_called.description: Indicates whether 5mC and 6mA methylation has been called and annotated in the BAM file's MM and ML tags

num_aligned_bases.description:
Number of bases in aligned reads

Notes: float type required for large number, but value entered should be an integer

num_aligned_reads.description:
Total aligned reads

Notes: float type required for large number, but value entered should be an integer

num_bases.description:
Number of bases (before/ignoring alignment)

Notes: float type required for large number, but value entered should be an integer

num_reads.description:
Total reads (before/ignoring alignment)

Notes: float type required for large number, but value entered should be an integer

quality_issues.description: describe if there are any QC issues that would be important to note

read_error_rate.description: Mean empirical per-base error rate of aligned reads

read_length_mean.description: Mean length of all reads (before/ignoring alignment)

read_length_n50.description: N50 is the shortest read length that, when all reads are sorted by length from longest to shortest, covers 50% of the total sequence data (longer is better). Value in kilobases

sex_concordance.description: Comparison between reported sex vs genotype sex; Other if ploidy NOT XX or XY and Other if sex at birth is not known, thus unable to perform sex concordance
